author: Hannah Goldstein
text: We are so lucky to work with the Green Latrine team! Not only do they provide a super high quality and clean product, they also have incredible customer service. Every part of the process has been easy with them, and they are super dependable. They even have helped us out super last minute (within 12 hours) for events, and go above and beyond to fix the smallest issues. If you need any bathroom trailer, portapotty, or water pump out services, we would highly recommend Green Latrine!! So many great team members, but especially shout out to Shawn :)
